Evaluating the function at $t=0,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}r(0) & =⟨\operatorname{tan}⁡(0),\,\operatorname{sec}⁡(0),\,\sqrt{0+3}⟩ \\  & =⟨0,\,1,\,\sqrt{3}⟩.\end{aligned}
$$

Computing the magnitude of this vector, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}|r(0)| & =\sqrt{{0}^{2}+{1}^{2}+{(\sqrt{3})}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{0+1+3} \\  & =\sqrt{4} \\  & =2.\end{aligned}
$$
